name: Aerospace CH UAV Co.,Ltd
summary: Aerospace CH UAV Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of UAVs and unmanned airborne guided missiles. It offers spin-wing drones, solar-powered UAV, hydrogen-powered UAV, medium and large-scale surveillance UAV, and UAV airborne weapons for various applications, such as Aviation geophysical prospecting, emergency communication, forest fire prevention, digital city surveying and mapping, oil pipeline inspection, and marine.
